warnings: No reference object in frame, so absolute size is not recoverable - a small onion near the lens looks identical to a large one far away. Relative sizes below are exact; for millimetres, include a coin or pass px_per_mm.

OUT OF THE CALIBRATED DOMAIN: its onions look unlike anything in the calibration set (median anomaly 0.32, against 0.30 for every one of the 53 calibration photographs). A different variety, camera, background or light will do this. Counts, outlines and relative sizes are unaffected. The defect percentages, and therefore the GRADES, may be systematically harsh or lenient here. First check the photo: onions on a plain surface, even light, no filters or screenshots. Only if this IS your normal set-up (new camera, variety or light), re-grade ~100 onions from it by hand and rerun audit/phase16_export_calibration.py.
